conventions.altitude: POS.RelHomeAlt at native ~5.1-6.4 Hz; time above a level by linear interpolation of the crossings, not by sample counting
conventions.coverage: track buffered by swath/2, intersected with the survey polygon in ENU -- an UPPER bound
conventions.gate_to_gate: (flown land - flown release) / (plan land - plan take-off); immune to the t0 convention AND to the ground wait
conventions.makespan: t0 = AUTO entry of the aircraft whose planned take-off delay is 0, minus that delay; touchdown = last downward crossing of 2.0 m AGL
conventions.separation_frame: exact WGS84 geodetic -> ECEF -> local ENU; continuous-time minimum on the union of both aircraft's native POS times
